fifi:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent character illustration for an educational GAN web application, a final production asset.
Primary request: Create FIFI, a delightful expressive small female-coded robot artist mascot. High-end 3D clay and soft vinyl collectible toy render, friendly intelligent playful confidence, tasteful and modern. Rounded oversized near-square cream ceramic head with dark plum glossy face screen, two bright coral pink expressive eyes and a subtle smiling mouth. Small violet beret tilted on head, coral red and muted lavender compact rounded body, stubby floating feet, tiny cream robot hands. She holds a slender digital paintbrush in one hand, its tip glowing soft peach, and gestures presenting her creation with her other hand. Small violet antenna. No human skin. Palette warm coral #ff7b70, violet #a89aff, warm ivory, deep plum. Full body three-quarter view facing slightly right, centered, feet and entire paintbrush inside frame. Consistent studio product lighting, soft ambient occlusion, crisp clean silhouette, beautifully crafted surface details. Transparent background, isolated character with no surrounding scene, no ground plane or cast rectangular background, no text, no labels, no watermark. Character fills about 85% of image with breathing room around all edges. Square image.
